biblical_reference.verse_reference: Genesis 29:35 - Leah bore Jacob a son, and she called his name Reuben; for she said, ‘Because the LORD has looked upon my affliction; for now my husband will love me.’ 30:1 - And she conceived again, and bore a son; and said, ‘Because the LORD has heard that I am hated, he has given me this son also:’ and she called his name Simeon.
biblical_reference.note: Leola is a biblical name mentioned in the Old Testament as the name of two women: Leah, who was the wife of Jacob, and the mother of several of his children; and Leah, who was the concubine of Jacob and the mother of his other children.
